t: Seder havvidduy bemincha beereb yom hakkippurim
s: Seder havvidduy bemincha beereb yom hakkippurim ubo t"z seipim: kevan sheyyom hakkippurim hu yom hasselicha vekappara, kemo shenneemar "ki bayyom hazzeh yekapper vego'", lepikak tzarik kol adam sheyyitvaddeh al chataayv, ki ken matzinu bekol qorbanot habbaim lekapper, shenneemar "vehitvaddu et chattatam asher asu". Umitzvat vidduy min haddin hu behatchalat zeman hakkappara, dehaynu mishshettechshak lel yom hakkippurim, ella shechashu chakamim shemma yeera debar qalqala shel shikrut vekayyotze bo basseuda hammapseqet velo yukal lehitvaddot behatchalat zeman hakkappara, lekak tiqqenu sheyyitvaddeh kol adam beereb yom hakkippurim bemincha qodem sheyyokal basseuda hammapseqet. Veap al pi shehitvadda bemincha — tzarik lachazor ulehitvaddot bearbit, shehi hatchalat zeman hakkappara, vehu iqqar zeman havvidduy shel yom hakkippurim, veap al pi shehitvadda arbit — chozer umitvaddeh bitpillat shacharit, shemma era lo debar abera achar havvidduy shel arbit, umittaam hazzeh hu tzarik lachazor ulehitvaddot bemusap ubemincha ubinila shemma era lo debar abera bekol hayyom, sheyyom hakkippurim mekapper ad sopo im chasheka:

Veyesh omerim shezzeman mitzvat vidduy min haddin hu qodem hatchalat zeman hakkappara, dehaynu im chasheka, kede sheyyiknos layyom bitshuba velo yehe shehut lachato ben havvidduy lehatchalat zeman hakkappara, ella shechashu chakamim shemma yeera lo debar qalqala basseuda velo yukal lehitvaddot im chasheka, lekak tiqqenu lehitvaddot bemincha, veap al pi shehitvadda bemincha — chozer umitvaddeh im chasheka, shehu iqqar zeman vidduy min haddin, shemma era lo debar abera achar mincha, veap al pi shehitvadda im chasheka — chozer umitvaddeh bitpillat arbit ubekol tepilla shel hayyom, lepi shebbevadday gam beyom hakkippurim atzmo chayyab lehitvaddot velashub bitshuba shelema. Vahalaka kassebara harishona. Mikkol maqom, rauy lekol adam lehachamir al atzmo kassebara hashsheniyya, ukesheroeh ben hashshemashot memashmesh uba — yaamod veyitvaddeh:

Keshehayyachid mitvaddeh, ben bitpillat mincha shel ereb yom hakkippurim ben bearbit shacharit musap mincha uneila shel yom hakkippurim — hu mitvaddeh achar sheggamar tepillato qodem sheaqar raglayv, abal hashsheliach tzibbur omer havvidduy beyom hakkippurim betok hattepilla. Abal bitpillat hammincha shel ereb yom hakkippurim — en hashsheliach tzibbur chozer et havvidduy beqol ram, dekevan shello tiqqenu havvidduy bemincha ella mishshum chashash shemma yeera debar qalqala basseuda, vehashsheliach tzibbur eno machazir et hattepilla ella kede lehotzi et mi sheeno baqi — lo ratzu chakamim letaqqen sheyyachazor sheliach tzibbur et havvidduy shemma yeera debar qalqala lemi sheeno baqi, shemmuatin hen sheenan beqiim:

Im lo peret et chataayv ella amar setam "chatati" — yatza yede mitzvat vidduy. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla nakon leparet et hachete sheyyomar "asiti kak vekak, mippene (shayvh"k) [sheal yede ken] hu mitbayyesh yoter lipne haqqadosh baruk hu mechataayv umitcharet alehem meomeq libbo. Ukeshehu meparet chataayv — yitvaddeh belachash, sheim yitvaddeh beqol ram — asur lo leparet chataayv barabbim, lepi sheen zeh kebod hammaqom shemmegalleh larabbim shechata kenegdo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechete sheen mepursam, abal chete hampursam larabbim — muttar leporto barabbim apillu beqol ram. Umikkol maqom en choba leporto beqol ram, ella yipretennu belachash im yirtzeh:
Umah sheomerim "al chete" al seder a"b — en zeh niqra poret chataayv, hoil vehakkol omerim beshaveh — eno ella kenosach tepilla, ulepikak muttar leomro beqol ram:

Seder havvidduy be"al chataim", sheanu chayyabim alehem ola, veachar kak chattat, veachar kak qorban oleh veyored, veachar kak asham vadday vetaluy, lepi shekkak sedurim haqqorbanot beparashat vayyiqra, veachar kak sheanu chayyabim alehem makkat mardut, veachar kak malqut arbaim, veachar kak mita bide shamayim, veachar kak karet vaariri, veachar kak arba mitot bet din, ki tzarik lebaqqesh al haqqal qal techilla veachar kak mosip veholek kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"b:

Yomar leshon kappara lachataim uleshon mechila laavonot uleshon selicha lappeshaim, ki hachete qal meavon veavon qal mippesha vehakkappara gedola mehammechila vehammechila gedola mehasselicha, lepikak hachete hu mitkapper, venimchal heavon, venislach happesha. Vetzarik lehitvaddot meummad, lepikak lo yismok al dabar beinyan sheim yinnatel oto dabar shehu somek alayv haya nopel kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"h. Vetob lishchot beet havvidduy kemo be"modim", kede lehitvaddot behaknaa gedola. Ukeshemmitvaddeh — yakkeh beegropo al halleb, kelomar atta garamta li hachete. Veyesh nohagin lehakkot al hechazeh mittaam hayyadua lahem:

Ap al pi shehitvadda bitpillat lachash, ap al pi ken keshehashsheliach tzibbur maggia levidduy — tzarik lachazor velaamod ulehitvaddot immo, ubevidduy zeh eno tzarik leparet hachete, ella kevan sheamar im hashsheliach tzibbur "abal anachnu chatanu" — day, verashshay lesheb achar kak, umikkol maqom en ledabber beshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur mitvaddeh:

Avonot shehitvadda alehen beyom hakkippurim sheabar ap al pi shekkebar nitkapperu — ap al pi ken yakol lachazor uleportan bevidduyo, velo od ella shehachozer uporetan — hare zeh meshubbach, shenneemar "vechattati negdi tamid", kelomar eni sabur shekkipparta li vahare hu tamid keillu hu negdi omed:
En chotemin bevidduy, ben vidduy shel ereb yom hakkippurim shel mincha, ben vidduy shel hayyachid achar tepillato bitpillot shel yom hakkippurim atzmo:

Nohagin sheachar tepillat hammincha beereb yom hakkippurim loqin kol haqqahal l"t malqot, veap al pi sheen malqot moil bizman hazzeh sheen lanu dayyanim semukin, vegam en chayyab malqot ella im ken hitru bo shehabbet din malqin oto, mikkol maqom nohagin lilqot, shemmittok kak yitten el libbo lashub meaberot shebbeyado, veod kede lehaknia lebabo velahakinah laabod hashshem hannikbad vehannora beema ubeyira:
Venahagu shehannilqeh omer vidduyim beshaa shennilqeh, vehammalqeh omer "vehu rachum yekapper avon vego'" g' peamim, shehem l"t tebot neged l"t malqot:
Venahagu lehalqot birtzua kol dehu, sheen zeh malqot gamur shetztzerika lihyot retzua rechaba tepach:
Veloqechin retzua shel egel, leorero bitshuba, al derek "yada shor qonehu". Abal en tzarik liqqach shette retzuot achat shel chamor kemo shehayu bemalqot gamur, kevan sheen malqot moil bizman hazzeh:

Vehannilqeh lo yaamod velo yesheb, raq mutteh achorayv laddarom upanayv latztzapon, lepi sheiqqar chete haadam hu mechamat mamon, uketib "mitztzapon zahab yeeteh", al ken yaknia et atzmo leoto ruach lehodia shemmishsham ba lo hachete:
Yom hakkippurim eno mekapper ella al hashshabim hammaaminim bekapparato, abal hambaet bo umechashsheb belibbo mah moil lo yom hakkippurim zeh — en yom hakkippurim mekapper lo:
